commentary.executive_summary: Latest forecast is below budget: revenue is NOK 21.16 million lower and gross profit is NOK 16.54 million lower. OPEX is NOK 8.48 million higher, resulting in EBITDA NOK 25.02 million below budget and an EBITDA margin 1.55 percentage points lower. Approved evidence supports a UK Sensor X distributor shipment delay and contractor acceleration within Product & R&D; the underlying causes of the other material variances remain unresolved.
